properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.api-key
properties.description: The IBM Cloud API key of the Speech to Text service instance. The client gets IAM access tokens with it. The endpoint fails to start without it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.configuration
properties.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and its endpoint options override the values. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.ibm.watson.stt.WatsonSpeechToTextConfiguration type.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.content-type
properties.description: The format (MIME type) of the audio for recognize, for example audio/wav, audio/flac, audio/mp3, audio/ogg or audio/webm. audio/l16, audio/alaw and audio/mulaw also need the sampling rate, as in audio/l16;rate=16000, and application/octet-stream lets the service detect the format. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTContentType header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the ibm-watson-speech-to-text component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.health-check-consumer-enabled
properties.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.health-check-producer-enabled
properties.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.model
properties.description: The speech model that recognize uses, for example en-US_Multimedia or en-GB_Telephony. The sampling rate of the audio must be at least 16 kHz for a broadband or multimedia model and 8 kHz for a narrowband or telephony model. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTModel header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.operation
properties.description: The operation that the producer performs: recognize transcribes audio, listModels and getModel return the speech models, and listCustomModels and getCustomModel the custom language models. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTOperation header replaces this option, and the producer fails if neither is set.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.service-url
properties.description: The URL of the Speech to Text service instance, for example https://api.eu-de.speech-to-text.watson.cloud.ibm.com. If not set, the IBM Watson SDK uses https://api.us-south.speech-to-text.watson.cloud.ibm.com, unless its external configuration, such as the SPEECH_TO_TEXT_URL environment variable, gives a URL.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.speaker-labels
properties.description: Whether recognize returns labels that identify which speaker spoke which words. The service then also returns the timestamps of the words, whatever the timestamps option is. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTSpeakerLabels header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.timestamps
properties.description: Whether recognize returns the start and end time of each word, in seconds. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTTimestamps header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watson-speech-to-text.word-confidence
properties.description: Whether recognize returns a confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 for each word. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTWordConfidence header replaces this option.
